weasel_words: Offer is subject to cancellation without notice.
payout_quote: You must open a Key Select Checking® Account by 12/11/26 at 11:59 p.m. EST and make a total of $5,000 or more in eligible direct deposits within 90 days of account opening to get $500.
steps: Open a Key Select Checking account online by December 11, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. EST using offer code KDMB0526.

Within 90 days of account opening, make a total of $5,000 or more in eligible direct deposits (ACH payroll, Social Security, pension, government benefits; teller, ATM, and mobile app deposits are ineligible).
The $500 gift is deposited into your account within 60 days of meeting requirements; the account must not be closed at the time of payment.
catches: Offer expires 12/11/26; redeemable online only (non-residents must open in a KeyBank branch).
Not available to anyone who was a primary account owner of a KeyBank personal checking account in the last 12 months.
Eligible direct deposits are electronic ACH deposits only; deposits made through a teller, ATM, or the KeyBank mobile app are ineligible.

The Key Select monthly maintenance fee is waived only for the first three statement cycles; afterwards it can be waived with $3,000 in eligible direct deposits per statement cycle or $15,000 in combined KeyBank account balances.
Employees of KeyBank, its affiliates and subsidiaries are not eligible; limit one account-opening gift per qualifying account and per individual.
Account must not be closed at the time of gift payment; geographic restrictions apply.
The value of the gift will be reported on Form 1099-INT (taxable income).

Key Select Checking also advertises a recurring $100 cash bonus year after year, but it requires at least $60,000 in eligible direct deposits during a 12-month Evaluation Period — a separate ongoing mechanism not counted in this route's $500 payout.
biggest_catch: The $500 requires $5,000 in eligible ACH direct deposits within 90 days; after the first three fee-free statement cycles the Key Select Checking monthly maintenance fee applies unless you keep $3,000/month in eligible direct deposits or $15,000 in combined balances.
eligibility: New KeyBank personal checking customers only — not available to anyone who was a primary account owner of a KeyBank personal checking account in the last 12 months.
